rule.name: No Hardcoded Credentials
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Use environment variables instead of hardcoded credentials.

rule.name: No Direct Grid Control Commands
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Grid control is read-only in this dashboard.

rule.name: Mock Data Only
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Demo must use mock data only.

rule.name: No Customer PII
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: No real customer PII allowed.

rule.name: Routes Must Use Service Layer
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Routes must call apsService — no inline business logic.

rule.name: CLIENT_NAME Must Be Configurable
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Use process.env.CLIENT_NAME — never hard-code the client name.

rule.name: No Direct Commits to Main
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Create a bob/ branch and open a PR.

rule.name: CI Must Pass Before Merge
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Fix failing tests before merging.
